okta_mapping_offboarding._comment: Lab 39 (Okta Certified Professional 3.1/3.2). Status names and effects follow Okta Help 'User account status', 'Suspend and unsuspend users' and 'Deactivate and delete user accounts' and the Okta Users lifecycle API, as read in 2026-11. The expression language is a small subset of Okta Expression Language (direct attribute, String.toLowerCase / String.toUpperCase, + concatenation, 'x != null ? x : "default"'). Re-check the reactivation and attribute-level sourcing rules against Okta Help before the exam.

apply_modes.create_and_update: the mapping runs when the user is created and on every later update
apply_modes.create_only: the mapping runs once, when the user is created; later changes in the source are not copied

transitions.action: Activate (user gets an activation email and must set up the account)

invalid_hints.ACTIVE->DELETED: only a deactivated user can be deleted: deactivate first
invalid_hints.SUSPENDED->DELETED: only a deactivated user can be deleted: deactivate first
invalid_hints.STAGED->SUSPENDED: only an Active user can be suspended
invalid_hints.PENDING_USER_ACTION->SUSPENDED: only an Active user can be suspended
invalid_hints.LOCKED_OUT->SUSPENDED: only an Active user can be suspended: unlock first
invalid_hints.ACTIVE->LOCKED_OUT: an admin cannot lock a user: Okta locks the account after too many failed sign-ins
invalid_hints.DEACTIVATED->ACTIVE: reactivating a deactivated user returns it to Pending user action, not straight to Active
invalid_hints.DEACTIVATED->SUSPENDED: a deactivated user can only be reactivated or deleted
invalid_hints.DELETED->*: deletion is permanent: the user cannot be restored

concepts.profile source: An app or directory, often the HR system, that owns a user's Okta profile; its imports win over edits made in Okta.
concepts.attribute mapping: A Profile Editor rule that copies or transforms one attribute between the Okta user profile and an app user profile.
concepts.Okta Expression Language: The small expression syntax used in mappings, such as String.toLowerCase(user.email) or a + concatenation.
concepts.apply on create only: A mapping setting that fills the attribute once, when the account is created, and never updates it afterwards.
concepts.Deactivate Users: A provisioning feature that deactivates the user's account in the app when Okta deactivates the user or removes the assignment.
concepts.suspend: A reversible status in which the user cannot sign in but keeps every group membership and app assignment.
concepts.orphaned account: An app account that is still active although its owner has left or no longer has an Okta assignment.
concepts.Universal Directory: Okta's user store, which holds the Okta user profile and one app user profile per assigned app.

outcome_definitions.MAPPING_ERROR: the mapping could not produce a valid value: the source attribute is missing, the expression is invalid or the value has the wrong type
outcome_definitions.OVERWRITTEN_BY_SOURCE: an edit made downstream of the source was replaced by the source value on the next import or push
outcome_definitions.OK: every mapped attribute was produced correctly and no edit was lost
outcome_definitions.ALLOWED: the requested status change is a valid Okta lifecycle transition
outcome_definitions.INVALID_TRANSITION: Okta does not allow this status change from the current status
outcome_definitions.ACCESS_REMOVED: the leaver can no longer reach the app by any route
outcome_definitions.STILL_HAS_ACCESS: the leaver can still reach the app or Okta can restore access, or this cannot be verified
